name: Activity Diagram
description: Activity Diagram describes workflow, algorithm or business process in the form of actions, conditional branches, parallelization, and responsibilities by swimlane.
purpose: Detailed specification of workflow, business process or algorithm with multiple decisions and fork/join.
bestFor: Detailed specification of flow inside a use case
Describe flow with decisions, fork/join, or swimlanes
notSuitableFor: Describe object lifecycle states → use State Machine Diagram
Describe actors and functional scope → use Use Case Diagram
Describe messages between services over time → use Sequence Diagram
useCases: Identify process start and end points
Add decision node for conditional branching
Add merge node to join branches

confusableWith.difference: Activity focuses on workflow/action; Sequence focuses on messages between lifelines over time.
Activity describes processing flow; State Machine describes states and transitions of an object.
Use Case tells what the system does; Activity tells how it is done.
